subject: 40th Anniversary Medford Junior Olympics
overview: Participants gathered for the 40th anniversary of the Medford Junior Olympics, featuring opening ceremonies and athletic competitions.

items.title: Welcome and Opening Ceremonies
items.summary: Principal Diane Gershow was welcomed to open the event, followed by the Pledge of Allegiance and the national anthem.

items.title: Athletic Competition
items.summary: Students participated in athletic events and field competitions.
